$comment: PTY companion single source of truth: version mirrors the paired node-runtime. Binaries are NOT committed; CI builds libpty_node.so (.github/workflows/build-pty-android.yml) and tools/provision.mjs deploys it. See docs/000-工程规划.md.

builtFrom.nodePty: node-pty@1.1.0 (npm, source unmodified; unix target src/unix/pty.cc)
builtFrom.nodeAddonApi: resolved from node-pty dependencies at fetch time

matrix.note: Companion to node-runtime; consumers MUST pair node-pty:<node> with node-runtime:<node> (identical NODE_MODULE_VERSION). Loaded from nativeLibraryDir via soname; do not dlopen from writable data dirs. The AAR bundles only libpty_node.so (libnode.so / libc++_shared.so are provided by node-runtime).
